story.titleZh: 加斯利再失摩纳哥大奖赛领奖台，迈凯伦与红牛上诉成功
story.summaryZh: 阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利在6月7日的摩纳哥大奖赛中获得第三名，但FIA国际上诉法庭裁定迈凯伦和红牛上诉成功，其两次因维修区超速所受的时间处罚被重新执行，红牛的伊萨克·哈贾尔重新获得第三名。
story.originalTitle: Pierre Gasly: Alpine driver loses Monaco GP podium for second time after McLaren, Red Bull win appeal
story.summaryEn: Alpine's Pierre Gasly lost his third-place finish at the Monaco Grand Prix after McLaren and Red Bull won their appeal at the FIA's International Court of Appeal, with Red Bull's Isack Hadjar reinstated to third.
detailZh: 皮埃尔·加斯利：迈凯伦和红牛上诉获胜后，这位阿尔派车手第二次失去摩纳哥大奖赛领奖台席位
6月7日的比赛经重新裁定，皮埃尔·加斯利的两次罚时被重新执行，红牛车队的伊萨克·哈贾尔被恢复至第三名；迈凯伦和红牛在国际汽联国际上诉法院胜诉；请通过天空体育F1频道观看意大利大奖赛直播，周日正赛时间为下午2点
伊萨克·哈贾尔在上诉获支持后重新回到摩纳哥领奖台，阿尔派车队对此表示不满，因为皮埃尔·加斯利因在维修通道超速而被处以的罚时被重新执行。
迈凯伦和红牛申诉成功后，阿尔卑斯的加斯利在六月摩纳哥大奖赛中被取消的处罚被恢复，他因此再次失去了该站的第三名成绩。
这意味着红牛的伊萨克·哈贾尔重新获得第三名，迈凯伦的皮亚斯特里回到第四名。
加斯利被重新列为第七名，小红牛的劳森和阿维德·林德布拉德分别排名第五和第六。

6月7日的比赛由梅赛德斯的安东内利夺冠，法拉利的汉密尔顿获得第二名。
加斯利原本在摩纳哥以第三名完赛，但在方格旗挥动后，立即因两次未执行的维修区超速五秒处罚而被降级。
加粗的车手在9月4日国际上诉法院（ICA）裁决后改变了名次
但阿尔派随后在五天后赢得了复议权，使加斯利恢复了第三名的成绩，因为阿尔派提交的证据被干事们认定为关于维修区内错误距离计算的一项“重要且相关的新要素”，证明这位法国车手实际上并未超速。
迈凯伦和红牛随后就加斯利的名次恢复向国际汽车联合会（FIA）的国际上诉法院提起上诉，听证会于8月25日在巴黎举行。

法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿、梅赛德斯的拉塞尔（他的处罚后来改为驶入维修区通道通过处罚（drive-through））以及迈凯伦的皮亚斯特里都受到了同样的超速处罚，但由于他们已经在比赛中执行了处罚，因此无法撤销。
在国际汽联上诉法院做出裁决后发布的一份声明中，国际汽联表示：“国际汽联正在审查当前一级方程式计时系统的方法和运作，以及相关的监管事务。它还将审查其他司法程序和运作，包括复审权和上诉程序。
小红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯对伊萨克·哈贾尔在摩纳哥大奖赛中恢复第三名的消息作出反应，此前皮埃尔·加斯利的两次时间处罚被重新执行。
国际汽联全力支持干事程序，以及由多元化干事小组组成的干事们的独立性和客观性，他们是全球赛车运动不可分割的一部分。
早在六月，天空体育F1的卡伦·钱多克就解释了为什么皮埃尔·加斯利在摩纳哥大奖赛受到的处罚被撤销了。
"干事们的决定是在与法庭不同的环境中做出的，而法庭可以获得大量额外的法律顾问意见、辩论和证据。"
"国际汽联的干事们会不断审视自己的工作流程，并参加大量的专业培训。国际汽联每次做出的决定都会被干事们仔细研究，以确保流程能够持续改进。"
“我们认为自己受到了不公正的处罚”——阿尔派对这一裁决表示不满。
在周五裁决公布后不久，阿尔派发布了他们自己的声明。
声明中写道：“车队对国际汽联国际上诉法院就2026年摩纳哥大奖赛结果作出的裁决表示失望和沮丧。”
皮埃尔·加斯利将摩纳哥大奖赛季军奖杯带回了阿尔派总部，并谈到自己迄今的职业生涯以及未来会有什么。
"虽然我们不认同这一决定，并且仍然完全坚持10号车在比赛中任何时候都没有超出维修区限速，但车队接受最近在巴黎举行的听证会上裁决小组的决定。"
"虽然这个结果不是我们所希望的，因为我们认为自己受到了不公正的处罚，但车队将全力专注于继续提升赛道上的表现，并仍在争夺一场势均力敌、竞争激烈的总冠军之战。"
在车队总冠军争夺第五名的较量中，阿尔派原本落后小红牛3分，但现在落后差距扩大到16分。
与此同时，红牛对恢复哈德贾成绩的决定表示欢迎，这重新确立了这位法国人为车队获得的首个领奖台。车队和车手的赛季积分也因此各增加了三分。
“这对伊萨克很重要，但我们觉得这对这项运动也很重要，”车队领队洛朗·梅基斯说。
“我们真的不希望一边比赛，一边还要在比赛结束后担心‘限速检查到底是对还是不对’。”
“在摩纳哥，很多赛车都遵守了限速规则。有些赛车超速了——其中一些接受了处罚，一些没有——重要的是我们要有一套一致的比赛方式。”
detailEn: Pierre Gasly: Alpine driver loses Monaco GP podium for second time after McLaren, Red Bull win appeal

Red Bull’s Isack Hadjar restored to third in the June 7 race after Pierre Gasly’s two time penalties were reapplied; McLaren and Red Bull won case at FIA's International Court of Appeal; watch Italian GP live on Sky Sports F1, with Sunday's race at 2pm
Isack Hadjar has been reinstated to the Monaco podium after an upheld appeal, with Alpine expressing frustration as Pierre Gasly's penalties for speeding in pit lane are reinstated.
Alpine's Pierre Gasly has lost his third-place finish from June's Monaco Grand Prix again after his penalties from the race were reinstated after a successful appeal by McLaren and Red Bull.
It means Red Bull's Isack Hadjar reclaims third place with McLaren's Oscar Piastri back into fourth.
Gasly is reclassified in seventh place with Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad fifth and sixth respectively.

The June 7 race was won by Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli with Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton second.
Gasly had originally finished third on the road in Monaco but was relegated down the order immediately after the chequered flag by two unserved five-second time penalties for pit-lane speeding.
Drivers in bold have changed position after September 4 ICA verdict

But Alpine subsequently won a right of review case five days later which restored Gasly to third after Alpine presented evidence which the stewards agreed was a "significant and relevant new element" regarding an incorrect distance calculation in the pit lane, showing the Frenchman was in fact not speeding.
McLaren and Red Bull subsequently appealed Gasly's reinstatement to the FIA's International Court of Appeal, with a hearing held in Paris on August 25.

Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton, Mercedes' George Russell (whose penalty was later converted into a drive-through) and McLaren's Piastri were all hit by the same speeding sanction but as they had already served the penalties during the race and they could not be undone.

In a statement released after the Court of Appeal's verdict was issued, the FIA said: "The FIA is reviewing the methodology and operation of the current Formula 1 timing system and the related regulatory matters. It will also be reviewing other judicial procedures and operations including the right of review and the appeal processes.
Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies reacts to news that Isack Hadjar has been restored to third in the Monaco GP after Pierre Gasly’s two time penalties were reapplied.
"The FIA is fully supportive of the Stewarding process and the independence and objectivity of the diverse panels of Stewards who are an integral part of global motorsport.
Back in June, Sky Sports F1's Karun Chandhok explained why Pierre Gasly's Monaco GP penalties were overturned.
"Stewards' decisions are taken in a different environment to that of the Court, whereas the Court has access to extensive and additional legal counsel input, arguments and evidence.

"The FIA Stewards constantly review their processes and take part in extensive professional development. Every decision of the ICA is carefully examined by FIA Stewards ensuring a process of continuous improvement."
'We feel we have been unjustly punished' - Alpine unhappy with decision
Alpine issued their own statement shortly after the verdict on Friday.
"The team expresses its disappointment and frustration with the outcome reached by the FIA International Court of Appeal relating to the result of the 2026 Monaco Grand Prix," read the statement.
Pierre Gasly welcomed the Monaco Grand Prix third-place trophy home to Alpine headquarters, discussing his career thus far and what the future holds.

"While we disagree with the decision, and still fully maintain that car #10 did not exceed the pit lane speed limit at any point during the race, the team acknowledge the decision of the judging panel from the recent hearing in Paris.

"While the result is not what we had hoped for, as we feel we have been unjustly punished, the team is fully focused on continuing to improve its performance on track and remains in a close and very competitive championship fight."
Alpine had been three points behind Racing Bulls in the fight for fifth in the Constructors' Championship but now drop 16 points adrift.

Red Bull, meanwhile, welcomed the decision to reinstate Hadjar for what now re-stands as the Frenchman's first podium finish for the team. Both team and driver's season points tallies are also boosted by an extra three points.
"It's important for Isack but we also felt it was important for the sport," said team principal Laurent Mekies.
"We don't really think we want to go racing and have to worry after the race 'was the speed-limit check correct or not correct?'

"A lot of cars have complied with the regulations in Monaco with the speed limits. Some cars were over-speeding - some of them served the penalty, some of them didn't - and it was important that we have a consistent way to go racing."

圣保罗大奖赛周五各节练习的集锦。
勒克莱尔表示，在圣保罗大奖赛的练习赛中经历了“最糟糕的感觉之一”后，他将对赛车做出“大幅”设定调整。
勒克莱尔在第二次练习赛中落后最快车手安东内利零点七秒，汉密尔顿则落后近半秒，法拉利在周五的速度不及梅赛德斯、迈凯伦和红牛。
这与他们近期的表现形成反差，法拉利在最近四场比赛中都登上了领奖台，但勒克莱尔希望他们能在周六下午2点30分的第三次练习赛和下午6点的排位赛中扭转局面，天空体育F1频道将直播。

勒克莱尔表示：“第二节练习非常棘手。实际上，如果要说的话，这是我今年在车里感觉最糟糕的一次，所以有很多工作要做，而且感觉不太对劲。”
“我有一些想法。我们会大幅调整赛车，看看效果如何。我希望我们能向前迈进一步，因为即使我错过了第一节练习，我也不认为那里有多少性能可挖。”
“只是纯粹的速度不够好。”
查尔斯·勒克莱尔表示，在上周墨西哥城大奖赛与法拉利队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿发生冲突后，他已“解决”了两人之间的不和。
汉密尔顿全天都在努力让轮胎达到工作温度，这可能成为整个周末的大问题，因为周六下午排位赛预报有雨，而周日将非常寒冷，气温仅15摄氏度。
“这是充满挑战的一天。赛道非常颠簸且湿滑，这让轮胎很难进入正确的工作窗口，”汉密尔顿说。
“第一节练习整体还可以，但第二节练习更加困难。我们收集了大量有用数据，今晚将与车队一起梳理这些数据，弄清在排位赛前赛车可以在哪些方面改进。”
法拉利车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔在墨西哥事件后回答关于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题
勒克莱尔：成为父亲是最特别的事情
勒克莱尔的妻子亚历山德拉周三诞下女儿比安卡后，他晚些时候才抵达巴西。
这位29岁的车手成为当前发车区第五位当父亲的一级方程式车手，前四位是马克斯·维斯塔潘、费尔南多·阿隆索、尼科·霍肯伯格和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯。
“这绝对是最特别的事情，”他说。
“你多少会期待这一刻，因为我一直想当个年轻爸爸，而且显然和亚历克斯在一起时，我们觉得时机对了，这是一个非常、非常特别的时刻。这一周绝对会因为我永远记住，全是积极的理由。
“当然，这期间也发生了其他事情。但对我来说，这一周全是关于比安卡的，真是太不可思议了。”

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Charles Leclerc plans 'significant' Ferrari car changes as Lewis Hamilton rues 'difficult' Brazil practice

Ferrari were off the pace compared to Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday in Brazil with both Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton unhappy about the car's balance; watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead Qualifying at 6pm live on Sky Sports F1 on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix
Charles Leclerc says he will make "significant" setup changes to his car after "one of the worst feelings" in practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Leclerc was seven tenths off pace-setter Kimi Antonelli in second practice and Lewis Hamilton was nearly half a second behind as Ferrari trailed Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday.

It was a contrast to their recent pace with Ferrari claiming a podium position in the last four races but Leclerc is hoping they can turn that around in final practice on Saturday at 2.30pm and qualifying at 6pm, live on Sky Sports F1.

"FP2 was very tricky. Actually, if anything, one of the worst feeling I've had this year in the car, so there's plenty to work on, and it didn't feel quite right," said Leclerc.

"I've got some ideas. We'll change the car quite significantly, and we'll see how it goes. I hope we can do a step forward because even though I missed FP1, I don't think there was much performance in that.
"It's just the raw pace wasn't great."

Hamilton struggled to generate tyre temperature throughout the day, something which could be a big issue throughout the weekend as rain is forecast for Saturday afternoon during qualifying, and Sunday will be very cold at just 15C.
"It was a challenging day. The track is very bumpy and slippery, which made it difficult to get the tyres into the right window," said Hamilton.

"FP1 was okay overall, but FP2 proved more difficult. We've gathered plenty of useful data, so we'll work through that with the team tonight to understand where we can improve the car ahead of qualifying."

Leclerc: Most special thing ever to become a father
Leclerc arrived late to Brazil after his wife Alexandra gave birth to a baby girl named Bianca on Wednesday.
The 29-year-old becomes the fifth Formula 1 driver on the current grid to be a father after Max Verstappen, Fernando Alonso, Nico Hulkenberg and Sergio Perez.
"It's definitely the most special thing ever," he said.

"You kind of expect it because I've always wanted to be a young dad, and obviously with Alex we felt like it was the right time, and it's a very, very special moment. Definitely a week I'll forever remember for all the positive reasons.
"Of course, there's been other things going on as well. But for me, this week was all about Bianca, and it's been it's been incredible."

detailZh: 圣保罗大奖赛：安东内利在英特拉戈斯赛道以梅赛德斯赛车领跑，领先于升级后的迈凯伦车手诺里斯。
观看周六下午2:30的最终练习赛，晚上6点天空体育 F1将直播排位赛。
圣保罗大奖赛周五练习赛精彩瞬间回顾。
作为F1新世界冠军，安东内利在赛道上完成了令人印象深刻的首日，并在圣保罗大奖赛第二场练习赛中设定了节奏。
在墨西哥成为该运动最年轻冠军五天后，安东内利在第一场练习中取得了第二快的成绩，并在蜿蜒的英特拉戈斯赛道上完成了更具代表性的第二场练习的最快成绩。
安东内利是唯一一位在圈速低于71秒的车手，他的基准时间1:10.763比最接近的挑战者兰多·诺里斯、P1的领跑者以及马克斯·维斯塔潘快了二十分之一秒。

但是，在周五的比赛中，诺里斯凭借自己最快的和第二快的成绩，也可以对自己的表现感到满意，因为麦凯轮车队对其MCL40赛车进行了升级。去年世界冠军，去年在圣保罗的获胜者，在长距离的比赛中也表现出色。
沃金车队是本周末唯一一支使用新部件的车队，他们试图在最后四轮比赛中反击红牛车队，在车队积分榜上超越对手，因为他们在维斯特潘在四场比赛中赢得三场胜利后，被对手超越了第三名。
乔治·拉塞尔紧随诺里斯和维斯特潘之后，在第二辆梅赛德斯赛车中排名第四快。他因为更换了新引擎，在本周末的比赛中将面临五位的发车位罚分。奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在另一辆麦凯轮赛车中排名第六。
但是，对于法拉利来说，这似乎是赛道上的一个更艰难的第一天，尤其是在短距离的比赛中。
在墨西哥站第一圈发生碰撞导致车队失去了一次可能的胜利，并促使周四晚上车手与车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔举行会议以澄清情况后，刘易斯·汉密尔顿以第六快的成绩，查尔斯·勒克莱尔以第七快的成绩。
法拉利车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔在两位车手之间发生公开争执后，回答了关于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题。
勒克莱尔在错过周四的媒体日和周五的第一节练习后，在周一从摩纳哥飞回，因为他的第一个孩子比安卡出生。
奥迪车队的尼古拉斯·胡肯伯格是经验丰富的车手中之一，他缺席了新手的开幕式练习，而可靠性问题导致他整日没有完成任何一圈。
在第一节的比赛中，英国年轻车手弗雷迪·斯莱特在仅仅完成了七圈后遇到了技术问题，而车队在第二小时努力修理它时，一个电气问题使得赛车在剩余的时间里都无法参赛。

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Kimi Antonelli fastest for Mercedes in second practice at Interlagos ahead of Lando Norris in upgraded McLaren
Watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead Qualifying at 6pm live on Sky Sports F1 on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Kimi Antonelli completed an impressive first day back on track as F1's new world champion to set the pace in second practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.

Five days after becoming the sport's youngest title winner in Mexico, Antonelli followed up his second-fastest time from first practice with the quickest of the more representative second session around the undulating Interlagos lap.

Antonelli was the only driver to lap below 71 seconds with his benchmark time of 1:10.763 proving two tenths of a second quicker than nearest challengers Lando Norris, the P1 pacesetter, and Max Verstappen.

But with fastest and second-fastest times of his own from Friday, Norris can also be satisfied with his day after McLaren introduced an upgrade to their MCL40 cars. The outgoing world champion, last year's winner in Sao Paulo, appeared quick on the longer runs too.

The Woking team are the only team in the field with new parts this weekend as they bid to hit back against Red Bull in the Constructors' Championship over the final four rounds after being overtaken for third by their rivals after Verstappen's run of three wins in four races.

George Russell was close behind Norris and Verstappen to finish fourth fastest in the second Mercedes. He carries a five-place grid penalty for a fresh engine into the weekend. Oscar Piastri was sixth in the other McLaren.
But it appeared a more difficult first day on track for Ferrari, particularly on the short runs.

Following the first-lap clash that cost the team a likely victory in Mexico, and prompted a Thursday evening meeting between the drivers and team principal Frederic Vasseur to clear the air, Lewis Hamilton was sixth fastest with Charles Leclerc seventh.
Ferrari Team Principal Fred Vasseur answers questions about Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after a public spat between the two,
Leclerc returned to the track after missing Thursday's media day and then Friday's first session after flying back from Monaco following the birth of his first child, Bianca, earlier this week.
Audi's Nico Hulkenberg was among the experienced drivers to sit out the opening session for rookies and reliability problems meant he ended the day without a lap on the board at all.

A technical problem had already stopped British youngster Freddie Slater after just seven laps while he was in the car in the first session and, while the team worked to repair it for the second hour, an electrical problem kept it sidelined for the rest of the day.
